meta.source: tamzit.org.il global styles (Elementor kit) and the logo files, September 2026

color.note: Built from the site's global palette and the logo. Light is the primary theme; dark keeps the same identity on the brand's deep navy.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen. Light is the site's #F2FAFD; dark is the site's deepest navy #021330.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar and inputs: anything that sits on surface.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Selected chips and options, the light square of the squares motif, the circle behind the mark. Text on it is ink or ink-muted, never link.

tokens.name: surface-hero
tokens.usage: Full-bleed navy: the audio player bar, the Shabbat screen, the paywall header. The logo's wordmark navy. Text on it is on-hero.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between news items and list rows. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, unselected chips and option cards, and the empty squares of the level meter. At least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface, surface-raised, surface-tint, good-soft, sun-soft and critical-soft (11:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Times, topics, captions and secondary copy on surface, surface-raised, surface-tint, good-soft and sun-soft (4.9:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-hero (14:1).

tokens.name: on-hero-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-hero, such as the player's elapsed time (7.3:1).

tokens.name: line-hero
tokens.usage: Hairlines and the progress track on surface-hero.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The site's primary navy: primary buttons, the active tab, filled level squares, the progress bar. In dark it becomes the site's sky accent so it stays visible. As text: on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a brand fill (10:1 in light, 9.8:1 in dark). Never literal white, because dark flips it.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The brand cyan, from the logo's tagline and the squares motif. Decorative only: the dark motif square, the tab indicator, illustration fills. Fails as text on light (2.6:1), so it is never text or the only mark of a state.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and quiet text actions on surface and surface-raised (5:1 or more). Light is the site's #0D77D8 darkened one step to pass 4.5:1 on surface. Not on surface-tint in light (4.1:1).

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: The site's coral: filled squares of a critical item's level meter and the critical dot. A graphic, 3.1:1 on surface and 4.5:1 on dark raised. Never a text color.

tokens.name: critical-ink
tokens.usage: The word “קריטי” beside the meter, on surface and surface-raised only (6:1 in light, 9.7:1 in dark). The site's wine and blush.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the critical filter option and error notes. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: The site's teal: the sprout icon's disc in “ונסיים בטוב” and the end-of-edition check. Decorative, never text.

tokens.name: on-good
tokens.usage: The sprout icon on a good fill (8:1). The site's dark green.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: The “ונסיים בטוב” card. Text on it is ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The site's yellow: premium, the supporter badge, the Shabbat candle glow. As a fill, its text is on-sun.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sun fill (10:1).

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Premium callouts and the highlighted plan's ribbon. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: Only the “שיתוף בוואטסאפ” button, as the site does.

tokens.name: on-whatsapp
tokens.usage: Label on the whatsapp fill (8.3:1), the site's own pairing.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: logo-plate
tokens.usage: A white plate behind the vertical logo and the לוקחים אחריות logo in the dark theme, since neither has a reversed file yet.

groups.name: App
groups.note: One family, as on the site. Ploni is the brand face (licensed, not bundled here); until its files are added, everything renders in Noto Sans Hebrew from Google Fonts, which covers Hebrew, English and French.

styles.name: tz-display
styles.usage: One per screen: the edition name, the onboarding question, the Shabbat greeting.

styles.name: tz-title
styles.usage: Section and sheet titles, plan names.

styles.name: tz-headline
styles.sample: גשם ראשון צפוי בסוף השבוע בצפון
styles.usage: The headline of each news item.

styles.name: tz-body
styles.sample: התחזית צופה ירידה בטמפרטורות ומטחים מקומיים, בעיקר בגליל ובגולן.
styles.usage: News item text. Generous leading for calm Hebrew reading; scales with the reader's text-size setting.

styles.name: tz-caption
styles.usage: Topic, time, reading time, descriptions under options.

styles.name: tz-overline
styles.usage: Section kickers above a title: “ונסיים בטוב”, “בקהילה שלך”, “פרסומת”.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label; between the level squares.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a kicker and its title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows of chips and between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; between a headline and its actions.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between news items; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Motif square size; air above the end-of-edition card.

radius.note: From the site: square blocks (0) for the motif, 20px cards, 100px pill buttons.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: The squares motif and the level-meter squares: the brand's square geometry.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small tiles: the app icon plate, archive date tiles, inputs. An addition for app-scale elements.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets (top corners), option cards, the share card. The site's card radius.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented controls, badges. The site's button radius.

shadow.note: Flat by default: cards are set apart by surface-raised on surface. Shadows only for what floats.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, the floating player bar, the share card preview.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the surface color, then 2px of solid brand (9.8:1 in both themes). Box-shadow, so it follows pill and card radii.

size.note: Hit areas and fixed app dimensions.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any tappable control.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar, before the device safe area.

tokens.name: player-height
tokens.usage: The mini audio player bar above the tab bar.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max measure of news text on tablets and the web.
